reference_sql:
SELECT c.category_name, p.product_name
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE c.parent_category = 'Accessories'
alternatives: SELECT c.category_name, p.product_name FROM products p RIGHT JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.parent_category = 'Accessories'
SELECT categories.category_name, products.product_name FROM categories LEFT OUTER JOIN products ON products.category_id = categories.category_id WHERE categories.parent_category = 'Accessories'

other_way.sql: SELECT c.category_name, p.product_name FROM products p RIGHT JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.parent_category = 'Accessories'
other_way.tradeoff: RIGHT JOIN returns the same rows when categories is written second, which helps when a long query already starts from products.
